I dedupe on txn_id before the POSTED filter, keeping the latest-ingested version, so a later REVERSED record overrides an earlier POSTED one.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC, CASE WHEN status = 'REVERSED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, txn_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
